title: Nonequilibrium coherent effects at finite chemical potential
summary: We study a nonequilibrium coherent effect generated by a finite chemical potential in a complex scalar field with a conserved $U(1)$ charge. The scalar excitation is treated as a probe coupled to an equilibrium thermal reservoir, so the self-energy is an equilibrium kernel and there is no backreaction on the bath. Solving the Schwinger-Keldysh-Kadanoff-Baym equations in the normal phase, when the chemical potential is smaller than the dispersion relation, we keep the particle and antiparticle quasiparticle poles separate.
